stem: Claire borrowed $20 from her mom in order to buy game tokens at a festival. Her mom said Claire would have to pay the money back with interest. Which statement best explains what Claire's mom meant?

options.label: A
options.text: She expected Claire to pay back only the money she borrowed.

options.label: B
options.text: She expected Claire to pay back only part of the money she borrowed.

options.label: C
options.text: She expected Claire to keep the money she borrowed and not pay any of it back.

options.label: D
options.text: She expected Claire to pay back the money she borrowed plus an additional amount of money.

difficulty_rationale: The problem requires understanding the meaning of 'interest' in a borrowing context, which is a straightforward concept for grade 3 level.
